reviews.text: this was one of the most unforgettable experiences on our trip. everything went incredibly smoothly and i couldn’t recommend this tour agency enough. the cruise departed and returned exactly on time. we boarded the cruise however quickly noticed the smell of fuel and smoke coming from the lower deck. due to this, and the obstructed views, we then opted for the vip section which was one of the best decisions ever. by paying 100 yuan extra, you gain access to the vip section which has the most spectacular and unobstructed views of shanghai’s skyline. there is also no smell as the vip is towards the front of the cruise. the staff were also very friendly and helpful throughout the cruise. while i wouldn’t recommend the standard section of this cruise, i would HIGHLY recommend the vip section.

Nice 1-hour cruise with great Shanghai skyline views, especially at night. Good price and on time, but the meeting point is a bit tricky to find. Worth it for the lights and atmosphere!. You can buy drinks but I didn’t do this time
Great way to see the evening lights of Shanghai skyline. Its a 45 minute cruise around the Bund area. There is extra charge for the top deck access but its worth the price.
The most famous little trip along the river in the evening and seeing the beautiful landscape and lights . Plenty of people on the boat and food if you want it. Not expensive and fascinating,
It was a nice one-hour cruise ride where we could see Shanghai skyscrapers. I would recommend buying tickets in advance, but it can depend on the day.
Fun experience on the river, easy to buy tickets, recommend paying the extra to sit at the front, includes some small snacks and beverages.

One of the tourist attractions in Shanghai. It is a good event, offers a good ride along the river with sightseeing of major attractions in Shanghai. The buffet was nice with a number of different dishes. Had to buy beer though, not complementary. If you’re in Shanghai, do plan for the cruise, it is relaxing

This was by far the best was to enjoy the city in all its glory at night, we were so lucky to have a perfectly clear night to enjoy unobstructed views across both sides of the river, old meets new, the river splitting them, allowing them both to shine respective of one another. We were able to get really good spot on the boat so we didn’t need to move at all, be sure to get there early as everyone rushes to the edges of the boats to get the best views and the locals don’t hesitate to push, especially in the so-called queue area, which is rather chaotic. But it’s so worth the madness to take in the views.

I followed some social media recommendations and took this RMB 2 one way cruise from the west bank of Huangpu River to the east bank. It was a short few minutes trip but the views were nice and the fare was so attractive. I believe the evening views will be stunning. I also took the cruise back from the east bank to the west bank. Come and enjoy this very economical cruise.

This was $30/pax in our group tour. It was enjoyable and fascinating. First floor has indoor viewing area with tables and chairs facing large windows. You can buy snacks and beverages here. Second level has private rooms I think, toilets, and limited outdoor view deck. Third floor was the roofdeck- everyone was here as it offers 360 degree view of the Oriental Pearl Tower side and the Bund. Such majestic colors, esp the golden lights along the Bund.

When it comes to experiencing the vibrant energy and breathtaking beauty of Shanghai, there's no better way than embarking on a Huangpu River Night Cruise. This iconic journey offers a front-row seat to the city's dazzling skyline, where the past and present of Shanghai come alive under the glow of neon lights and starlit skies. The Huangpu River, often referred to as the "Mother River of Shanghai," divides the city into two distinct yet harmonious halves: Puxi, the historic western side with its colonial architecture and the famous Bund, and Pudong, the futuristic eastern side boasting soaring skyscrapers like the Shanghai Tower and the Oriental Pearl Tower. As the sun sets and the city lights begin to sparkle, the river becomes a mirror reflecting the soul of Shanghai. The night cruise lasts about an hour, offering ample time to soak in the views and capture unforgettable memories. Modern, well-equipped boats provide both indoor and outdoor seating, ensuring comfort regardless of the weather. As you glide along the river, you'll be treated to panoramic views of: • The Bund: A stunning stretch of historic buildings illuminated in golden hues, showcasing Shanghai's colonial past. • Pudong's Skyline: A futuristic marvel of towering skyscrapers, including the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower and the Shanghai World Financial Center, lit up in a mesmerizing display of colors. • Bridges and Waterfronts: The river is dotted with beautifully lit bridges, such as the Nanpu Bridge and Yangpu Bridge, adding to the visual spectacle.

This is a must do in Shanghai!! And do it at night so you can see this amazing landscape with lights! It takes about 45 minutes and you can enjoy the views from outside the boat. There is enough space on the boat for many people so there's no need to rush to get on.
Came here in an evening with bad weather but the cruise tour worths it! Highly recommend when you are in Shanghai

I’m deeply disappointed with the attitude of the staff manning the entrance at Level 1. Their behavior came across as arrogant and lacking in empathy. We had one person with a disability and four elderly individuals over the age of 75 in our group. It was disheartening to see that no initiative was taken to offer any form of assistance or leeway until we had to reason with them face-to-face. It’s troubling that compassion and understanding were not extended from the outset, especially to those with visible needs.
Took a day cruise without food. Nice cruise to observe landmark buildings in Shanghai.

This is a must-do activity when in Shanghai. We did the skyline view of the Bund earlier in the day and we finished this off with the Huangpu River Cruise to take in the scenic view at night from the river. The upper deck was crowded so we opted to pay 100yuan each more for a VIP viewing deck with unlimited snacks and refreshments. It was a bit chilly that day but we had so much fun.
Don't take the 120 rmb luxury ride. It's lousy service with no lift or escalator. Everything is stairs at night. Once you get in, everything is additional charges. Lousy

Evening cruise on the river Huangpu is the best way to admire the Bund in all it's glory. The cruise starts from the Wharf near the Bund, cost: 150 yuan, duration : just under 1 hour. Be prepared for lots of queuing, but definitely worth the visit.

One of the best river cruises in the city. We were the only ones in the "First" class cabin which opens straight onto the viewing deck. Very cool experience to have the whole cabin with a private deck. It did get windy and cold but that was fun. Got to see a lot of cool buildings along the river. Definitely a repeat if I am back in the city

Stunning views! The only negative thing is that the boats are too full and you have to “fight” for the good spot to have a good view. Recommend taking VIP ticket, not much price difference to normal one. There are not that many people in VIP area and you get some drinks and snacks together with place to sit down and better view spots.

Passengers embark on a scenic journey along the Huangpu River aboard a sightseeing boat. Highlights of the Huangpu River Cruise typically include: The Bund: Passengers can admire the historic architecture of the Bund, featuring well-preserved colonial buildings from Shanghai's past, juxtaposed against the modern skyline of Pudong. Pudong Skyline: The cruise offers stunning views of Pudong's towering skyscrapers, including the Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai Tower, Jin Mao Tower, and Shanghai World Financial Center. Waibaidu Bridge: The Waibaidu Bridge, also known as the Garden Bridge, is a historic landmark spanning the Huangpu River. Passengers can see this iconic bridge up close during the cruise. Night Cruises: Evening cruises are particularly popular, as passengers can witness the city illuminated by the dazzling lights of its buildings and landmarks, creating a magical atmosphere.

We did the 50 minute Classic cruise in a Yacht starting from Shiliupu wharf on the Bund. Night cruise is better as you get to admire Shanghai's classic skyline views of all the most incredible architecture and modern skyscrapers all lit up in a vast amount of bright lights and colours along the River

A must must and not to be missed experience while visiting shangahi. Take the river cruise. Shangahi looks so beutifull from the sea . You can see the pudong District and bund and old British era building. It's extraordinary.

I had toured the river in big cruise ships three times in past, twice in 1984 & 2006 cruise was during day time & last time along with my wife & son we cruised in 2019 in evening. Scene during evening was wonderful as the tall buildings & towers at eastern Pudong & classical buildings at western The Bund was illuminated beautifully. It was nearly one hour trip & food was available for purchase. I am the witness & really appreciate the rapid development of city & growth of living standard of people. We really enjoyed our cruise & took plenty of good pictures from the deck. A must to do activity while at Shanghai.

Absolutely amazing way to see Shanghai at night. The view around on the river was absolutely incredible, and everything was lit up. It was a tad foggy that night but it did not affect our view. I would definitely recommend taking a scarf and hat in case you want to stand outside. They did charge 50 yuan to go to the upper most level of the deck, which I did not do, the view was just fine on the deck below.
Boat tour is quite nice. The city of Shanghai looks stunning from the water. It can get crowded so it is best to purchase your ticket early and not wait for the last minute.

It's ok, worth doing at night but take a jacket as it's windy. It's not guided so you are just looking, therefore 45 mins is more than enough. There are only seats downstairs and inside, better views on the decks but standing only and bit chilly in late October, we were fine but if unable to stand make sure you get on first for a seat downstairs.

This is the best way to see the lights and city sights along the river. The sights of the Bund are seen best from the middle of the water. Popcorn on board was substandard, but that wasn't what I was there for. This was also the only place I was able to find a Shanghai snow globe to purchase.
Nice scenery. Worth to take a look once. People tend to rush and push so must be careful. Cruise has a lot of space so don't know why they need to push and rush.
All escalator were not functioning. Not user friendly for elderly and kids. If U want to have proper view in the top deck. You need to pay extra. Not worth the money.

Get your ticket early and wait in line so you can have a good spot for viewing. There's vending machines and restrooms inside the waiting room, and toilet on the boat too. Amazing views of downtown especially lit up at night.

This is such a brilliant city to see at night and a cruise is a gr w at way to see both the new and old. The lights are awesome. Just a little warning though - there was not enough seats for everyone in fact at least half of those on board were standing. Not a big deal if you are up for standing about 45 mins
Very impressive. It would be very windy and you will stand for the whole cruise if you don't want to pay extra. But it is worthy and you will have a unforgettable view of the river
The cruise ship is big and spacious. The ride is about 40 - 45 minutes. Nice view of The Bund at night, scenic. Recommended for first time visitors.

This is in my opinion a night activity however do be mindful that the lights go off at 10.00pm sharp. So if you want time to appreciate the beauty of this place lit up you need to be on the boat by 8.30pm to be safe. Hop on right after dinner .. that’s what we did

Best way to enjoy the view of The Bund area. Ticket is RMB100 for one hour cruise and that'll be RMB120 for cruising above 6 PM (when all the building's lights turned on). It has 3-4 floor, you can enjoy the view on the upper deck with the wind breeze or from the lower where it's warm and safe from the cold wind. The good side is there aren't too many people, so we can enjoy the cruise peacefully. There are snack corner you can buy some popcorn or any other beverages inside.
A must do in Shanghai. Outstanding view of the skyline. Not so expensive at $18 (US).

Lovely boat and cruise. Was a smooth and chill paced cruise along the river where you can see all the city skyline, colours and sights of Shanghai. The slower speeds means you can get some nice photos of the city sceneries with you in it. There is a cafe and restrooms on board and a VIP areas which you can pay for to have a less crowded view but on our visit we didn't have much of a crowd so was super lucky to enjoy the best experience.
The Huangpu River Cruise was an incredible experience! I could see one of the most stunning night view of Shanghai. Strongly recommend to have a seat on the top deck.
Very memorable moment for lifetime. An enthusiasts and adventurous journey for me and my group. Really beautiful.
Amazing to go at night time, you get to see all of new Shanghai lit up at night and the Bund which has the English architecture.

The queque and toilets are horrendous. No proper management of this tourist place. Some places at the boarding place is not well lighted. Not suitable for those physically challenged as all elevators and escalators are closed and they refused to switched them on. Customer service are very bad and the people manning the queque were very rude

The evening I took this tour, the weather was perfect. It was not too hot or cold. Shanghai's weather reminds me of Nee Orleans. It's mild in winter. The cruise showcases the amazing architecture from old China to modern day. All the buildings are decorated with lights. It's a nice relaxing ride on a beautiful rive.

Worth the experience compared to the fees charged but the ticket booth is quite a distance from the pier to board on the cruise. Nice time to be on board is in the evening. Colorful decorated buildings with LED lights along the river. You have to be there early to get the good spot of view on the cruise. After the river cruise, there is a lot of restaurants to choose from to spend time until late night.

The Huangpu River cruise was enjoyable, but a drawback was the absence of seating, as they were cordoned off by the staff. Standing for an extended period of 50 Minuted became tiring. Nevertheless, the overall experience was positive.
Thoroughly recommend this cruise. The light show was impressive. Great views of the city from the river
Nice to see the city of Shanghai along the river. The weather is quite cold as it is windy. But still make me excited to enjoy the cruise. Worth to try this attraction when you visit Shanghai.

A short half hour cruise down the Yang-tze that showcases the modern Shanghai with its many high rises and European styled architecture, all lit up with millions of lights, is truly an amazing sight in the night. Entry & exit to the ferry is very orderly.
Charcoal custard lava buns are a variation of salted egg custard buns, which originated in Southern China. The buns are made with a sweet and savory custard filling and a charcoal-infused dough.

For 120rmb the boat ride took us around the riverbank to look at the light on the buildings along both sides of the riverbank. Just stayed at one place to catch all buildings. Our boat left at 6:10pm. The time was about 50 minutes round trip. The VIP section was 50rmb which bought you a seat and small snacks.

This was a lovely cruise on the river to view the lit buildings along the river side. Very pretty and relaxing. Aboht an hour or hour and a half cruise. The wait to noard can be a little long so be prepared but once they begin boarding it moves quickly. Can be chilly on deck.

The river boat cruises leave from a ferry terminal. The river cruise boats leaves about every half hour in the evening. The boat cruises on both sides of the river for about fifteen minutes in each directions. There were long lines waiting to board the boat. The decks are opened with no seating areas. The buildings on both sides of the river have their lights on with the company logos. The lights on some of the building changes colors. The river boat cruises have a very good view of all the tall building along the river.

The windows in the cruise are not fully maintain for a nice shoot. Totally disappointed with the Price RMB120 paid for. Rainy day will make the view even more lousy with bad air ventilation when u r located at level 1.

The food is low quality and no beverages are included in the price. Not even water. The lineup to the buffet is poorly organized and you have to deal with budging, pushy people who cut infront of you. Other than the disappointing buffet experience, the boat was decent experience.

Taking the 50-minute Huangpu River cruise is a relaxing way to have panoramic view of Shanghai with the west-meets-east, tradition-hits-modernity feature. Travelers can witness the magic and enjoy “An Exhibition of International Buildings” on its western bank and breathtaking, fabulous skyscrapers of Lujiazui on its eastern bank. The Huangpu River, known as the Mother River of Shanghai as well as the largest river in Shanghai, is a 113-kilometer long river flowing through Shanghai which is the last tributary of Yangtze River ends into East China Sea. This magical river cuts across Shanghai city, dividing it nearly into two region: Puxi (West Bank) and Pudong (East Bank). The western side or Puxi is home to “An Exhibition of International Buildings” with various international architectural styles and most of historical tourist attractions. The eastern side or Pudong is a recent development of the last few decades and is the new business and financial district boasting many awesome glass and steel towers, like Shanghai Oriental TV Pearl, Shanghai Tower, Shanghai World Financial Tower and Jinmao Tower. To enjoy the west meets east, tradition mixs with modernity culture along Huangpu River, to appreciate the breathtaking skyscrapers in relaxing way, to catch a glimpse of life blood of Shanghai, you can take a cruise leisurely sailing on Huangpu River - no matter in the daytime or at night.
Amazing experience with this river cruise. It's an experience you can never forget. On either bank of the river, it feels like some European nation.
120 RMB for a 45 minutes tour is a good deal. The boat was a modern and quiet boot, with beautiful views of both sides of the Huangpo river.

Kind of crazy when you are boarding if it's busy. We were like pushed to the VIP section when we didn't want to be there, by the time we figured out what was happening, most of the seats in the normal sections were taken Haha. It was crazy, but the sites were like nothing I've seen before!
You can see beautiful buildings and lights. You also can buy VIP tickets on the boat and it provide special seat and more~
Shanghai have one of the best skylines in the world, and the best way to enjoy the attraction is from river cruise at night, superb nightscapes!
Very beautiful scenic river cruise. Different coloured lights flood the buildings at the bank of the river making Sanghai beautiful
A fantastic experience on a great ship, the Victoria Jenna. A magical journey through the Yangtze. A must do when traveling to China.
Good view and great fun. The best part was rushing with the locals to get a place by the veranda.
It was one of a kind experience. Worth it and i'd love to come back soon. Highly recommended tourist destination.
Beautiful scenery. Love the rides. Wonderful and romantic experience. Recomended.
Nice view...but the location in google map was wrong. Should be further down around 200m. Ticket at lower ground.
Breath taking view of Shanghai from cruise. Ideal to refresh anyone after a long tiring day

Una de las mejores experiencias nocturnas en Shanghái. Navegar por el río Huangpu al anochecer permite disfrutar de una vista privilegiada del Bund iluminado por un lado y del impresionante skyline futurista de Pudong por el otro. El contraste entre edificios históricos y rascacielos modernos es simplemente espectacular. El crucero es tranquilo, cómodo y muy fotogénico, ideal para relajarse después de un día intenso de visitas. Aunque la duración no es muy larga, el recorrido concentra algunos de los mejores paisajes urbanos de la ciudad, especialmente cuando se pasa frente a la Oriental Pearl Tower y los grandes rascacielos. Consejo: intenta situarte en la cubierta exterior para disfrutar mejor de las vistas y las fotos, y evita las horas punta si puedes. Muy turístico, pero totalmente recomendable y fácil de organizar.
黄浦江游船之旅非常不错，也很愉快。我们等了大约二十分钟船才到。上船后如果想去上层甲板，需要另外付 20 元的费用，不过上面有椅子可以坐着休息。从船上可以看到黄浦江和外滩的许多著名地标，作为一个基础设施爱好者，看这些景观真的很过瘾。游船行驶得又快又平稳，虽然天气有点冷，但有一位会说西班牙语的工作人员在发毛毯，我还用自己的西语和他聊了几句，非常友好。整体体验很棒，非常推荐给来上海的游客！

Plimbarea pe rău a durat cca 40 de minute, însă poți face fotografii spectaculoase. Toate clădirile sunt iluminate între orele 17-23; cred ca lumina se aprinde de la un singur buton, pentru ca am avut surpriza deosebită de a vedea momentul! Fascinat.

마일리얼트립에서 예약했고 19:55 출발 크루즈였고 1시간정도 운행했다. 옆에 있는 上海外滩英迪格酒店(十六铺店) 상하이 분드 인디고호텔 앞에서 가이드분한테 19:20쯤에 티켓 수령하고 바로 들어가니 거의 맨처음으로 승선할 수 있었다. 투어 가이드 단위로 오는 손님들도 많아서 북적북적한 분위기였다. 사진을찍기 위해서는 크루즈 기준 3층으로 올라가야하고 2층에는 선실 내부에 의자에 앉아서 관람할 수 있었다.(주로 나이 많은 어르신들이 앉아계셨다)당일 비가 내리기 시작해서 조금 아쉬운 점 빼고는 정말 만족스러운 경험이었다.

Sudah dua kali ke tempat ini, dulu dengan Mami, sekarang dengan suami. Antri panjang menuju kapal, karena kebagian tiket jam 20.30 malam. Angin malam hati-hati, pakai baju hangat dan jangan lupa pakai masker karena terkena asap kapal. Pemandangan kota Shanghai malam yang sangat indah, gedung2nya berjajar dengan cantik dan mempesona. Perjalanan dengan kapal kurang lebih 1 jam, jadi puas memandang gedung-gedung cantik di malam hari. Jujur, lebih cantik dari Hongkong (Simfoni cahaya dari Victoria Harbour).

I took a cruise on the last day of my trip to Shanghai, it was really impressive. I highly recommend you to try it. It was nice to see the night view on both sides of the Huangpu River. 상해에 여행 마지막날에 한번 타보는 걸 추천드려요.

disini bisa naik kapal pesiar buat keliling sungai, keliling nya 1 x tapi panjang, yang naik banyak jadi ramai, ada antriannya juga, angin nya kenceng dan udaranya dingin karena abis ujan, pemandangan nya bagus, kota nya punya banyak lampu, seru banget
상하이 야경을 한눈에 둘러보는 환상적인 리버 크루즈 동방명주를 비롯한 상하이 국제금융센터를 비롯 마천루를 이룩한 국제도시 상하이 야경이 환상적이다 사회주의국가의 일관된 힘이 느껴진다

상해에 와서 유람선을 타봐야지 상해의 발전상을 한눈에 볼수있을 만큼의 전경이 강을따라 펼쳐져 있음. 특히나 야간에 타야지 고층 건축물에서 그려지는 화려한 빛의 놀림은 전세계 최고의 전경을 보여줌. 홍콩도 상해의 전경을 따라가지 못함. 더군다나 홍콩은 거리가 멀지만 상해는 가까워서 더 실감이남. 다만 배안에 좀더 넓른 전망대와 의자가 설치되었음 좋겠다. 사람이 많아 배난간에는 좀처럼 접근할수가 없어서 사진 찍으려면 앞사람 수박통 땜시 사진 찍기가 애매함.

Excelentes vistas del Bund y del distrito financiero con sus mùltiples rascacielos iluminados de mùltiples colores. Un gran espectàculo para nuestros ojos. Los cruceros duran unos 45 minutos. Es muy recomendable tomar posesiòn de la barandilla con apoyo de codos para no encontrar sorpresas, ya que los locales tienen un sentido de la cercanìa distinto sl europeo, y aconsejo el lado derecho para tener mejores vistas al regreso. El rio Huangpu tiene 113 km de longitud y es una ramificaciòn del rìo Yangtsè.
관광객이 너무 많을 때는 2시간 정도는 기다려서 타야하는 기다림은 있지만 일단 유람선을 타고나면 기다림을 보상 받는 멋찐 야경을 즐길 수 있습니다!! 중국에서는 야경을 위해 건물의 전기료를 지원해준다고 하네요. 사진 찍기 명소이기도 하지만 시원한 바람을 느끼면서 가볍게 맥주 한 잔 할 푸있는 공간들도 있어 좋습니다.
Passeio noturno por Shangai é imperdível. Vale muito a pena, e sugiro locar uma lancha exclusiva, é mais tranquilo.
Обязательное посещение набережной с речным круизом по Хуанпу. Лучшее время на закате

Une magnifique expérience à faire de nuit. Si cela peut sonner comme un attrape touriste, faire une croisière d'une heure sur la rivière Huangpu à bord d'un bateau, fait partie d'un des plus beaux moments que j'ai passé à Shanghai. Alors oui c'est bondé, oui le bateau n'a pas beaucoup de charme et la rivière ressemble plutôt à une autoroute de touriste qu'un havre de paix, mais cela est le prix à payer pour profiter d'une vue exceptionnelle sur le Bund et Huangpu.
Nie można tego pominąć będąc w Shanghaiu,zwłaszcza rejs nocą robi ogromne wrażenie.
Bonito paseo por el río. Si vas en invierno abrígate pues la brisa es para congelarte 😜

40분 정도 운행합니다. 여행관련어플에서 티켓 미리사면 싸요. vip실은 배 꼭대기까지 계단 올라가고나면 거기에서 돈추가요금 현금내고 들어가는 곳 있습니다. 지금은 한명당 100위안 추가입니다. 그 긴 시간동안 중국인들과 낑겨서 씨끄러운곳에서 서서 야경 보느니 저희는 돈내고 들어갔습니다. vip들어가서 야외로 나가서 조용하고 여유롭게 의자에 앉아서 야경 감상하세요.
상하이 유람선 꼭 타보시길 권장합니다. 대기시간이 조금 긴편이나 경관은 예술입니다. 배에서 앉아서 조망볼수있는 곳이있는데 추가요금 내시면 맥주랑 안주 드실수 있습니다 추가요금 내더라도 그게 좋아요 조망보는 곳 표는 배안에서 사시면 됩니다.
유람선에서 본 상해 야경이 너무 멋있었어요. 동방명주, 노랑 나비, 126층 빌딩 야경, 건물 마다 다른 모양과 색깔로 알록 달록.. 상해 가면 꼭 보세요.
